title: מערת קברים עתיקה בירושלים (ancient tomb cave in Jerusalem, Qiryat Moshe)
author: S. Gudovitch
location_note: Yard of the state religious school, Qiryat Moshe, Jerusalem; no map reference.
notes: Robbed in antiquity; a Herodian lamp dates it.

features.subtype: tomb cave with three kokhim
features.period: Early Roman period (1st century BCE to mid-2nd century CE, as printed)
features.quote: שזו מערת קברים מן התקופה הרומית הקדומה

title: מערת קברים יהודית על הר-הצופים (Jewish tomb cave on Mount Scopus)
author: N. Avigad
location_note: Hebrew University grounds, Mount Scopus; no map reference.
notes: Four rock-cut chambers lined with ashlars and vaulted; inscribed ossuaries (Hananya bar Yehonatan) and two stone sarcophagi, one richly decorated.

features.subtype: family tomb of four ashlar-lined vaulted chambers with ossuaries and two sarcophagi
features.period: probably the burial estate of a wealthy family in Herod's days
features.quote: היתה זאת ככל הנראה נחלת קבורה של משפחה אמידה בימי

title: אבו ע'וש - 1967 (Abu Ghosh, Neolithic site)
author: G. Dollfus and M. Lechevallier (J. Perrot)
screen_note: Spelling variant 'אבו ע'וש' of the gazetteer's 'אבו גוש' (exploratory).
location_note: Abu Ghosh prehistoric site; no map reference.

features.subtype: headless human skeleton in contracted position, 0.60 m below the floors
features.period: Pre-Pottery Neolithic B (Jericho phase B)
features.quote: נחשף שלד אדם ללא ראש בתנוחה מכווצת

title: ירושלים. מצד "מעלה רומאים" (Jerusalem, Herodian road fort, Giv'at Shaul)
author: V. Tzaferis
location_note: Near the new Ezrat Nashim hospital, Giv'at Shaul; no map reference.
notes: Two-storey Herodian fort guarding the Roman road to Emmaus; Byzantine building with five dwelling units and a mosaic workshop; later a lime-slaking installation. No feature of the eligible classes.

title: שימור ושחזור: מצודת ירושלים; עין חמד (conservation: Jerusalem Citadel; En Hemed)
author: (Department of Antiquities, Y. Minzker)
screen_note: En Hemed (Aqua Bella) is not in the gazetteer; it lies inside the Z4 box (exploratory by-eye match).
location_note: Jerusalem Citadel; En Hemed (Aqua Bella, Deir el-Banat); no map references.
notes: Citadel: war damage and removal of Jordanian additions (no eligible feature). En Hemed: Crusader monastery conserved; 'the spring and the water systems by the spring' supervised; the water systems are not described (class INFERENCE).

features.subtype: water systems by the spring (not described), conserved with the Crusader monastery
features.period: not dated in the report
features.quote: המעין ומערכות המים שליד המעין

title: חפירות בירושלים 1967 (excavations in Jerusalem 1967, K. M. Kenyon)
author: K. M. Kenyon (report quoted)
location_note: Ophel ridge, east slope above the spring, and the south-west corner of the Old City; no map reference.
notes: Kenyon's own summary of the last season. A pit of the post-destruction period (perhaps 6th century BCE) on the western ridge not coded (pit only). Walls not eligible.

features.subtype: quarries outside Aelia Capitolina that cut through earlier remains
features.period: begun by Herod at the end of the 1st century BCE; main destruction under Aelia Capitolina
features.quote: הראו שהורדוס החל בתהליך זה בסוף המאה הראשונה

features.subtype: rock-cut cisterns whose roofs were destroyed by the quarrying
features.period: earlier than the quarrying; not dated
features.quote: אשר הרסו את תקרותיהם של בורות חצובים

features.subtype: artificial cave outside the walls with about 700 vessels and Hebrew inscriptions, interpreted as a store for cult vessels
features.period: not dated in this summary
features.quote: התגלית העיקרית היתה מערה מלאכותית מחוץ לחומות

title: ירושלים: קברים מימי בית שני בארנונה (Jerusalem, Second Temple period tombs at Arnona)
author: S. Ben-Arieh (V. Tzaferis)
location_note: Arnona, Jerusalem; no map reference.
notes: Round plastered domed entrance hall (diameter 2 m) opening to three caves; west cave with four resh-shaped kokhim and five ossuaries; north cave with four kokhim and ossuaries (one with a Hebrew inscription fragment); an irregular cave without kokhim used for bone collection.

features.subtype: tomb complex: round entrance hall and three caves (kokhim, ossuaries, blocking stones)
features.period: Herodian (lamps and pottery)
features.quote: וממנו הובילו שלושה פתחים לשלוש מערות

title: שימור ושיחזור: ירושלים (conservation: Jerusalem Citadel and walls)
author: (Department of Antiquities and Jerusalem municipality)
location_note: Citadel, Phasael tower and city walls; sub-item of the conservation report.
notes: 'פצאל' in this text is the Phasael tower of the Citadel (namesake of the gazetteer's Phasaelis). No feature of the eligible classes.

title: סקר ארכיאולוגי של ישראל: סקר באיזור שכם (survey of the Shechem area)
author: E. F. Campbell (reported)
location_note: Shechem plain; five new tells with map references (Kh. Suwwar 1811/1779, el-Kharaba 1796/1805, Diara 1805/1805, Rujib 1780/1774 in Z1; Tell Kuma 1707/1852 outside); Salim 1815/1796.
notes: 41 sites; settlement history by period. 'Very interesting details about the water supply' of Aruma (Kh. el-Urma) are mentioned but not described; not coded. No feature of the eligible classes described.

title: הר אפרים ובנימין – מרכז (חולייה מס' 5) (emergency survey, central Ephraim and Benjamin)
author: Z. Kallai
location_note: Survey area from Jerusalem to Mount Ebal (Z1, Z3 and Z4 parts and outside the boxes); one map reference (1737/1647, outside).
notes: Settlement history by period (Ein Fara, Kh. Marjama, Kh. Radana, Nebi Samwil area, Gerizim slopes, Michmash, Almit, Geba, Gibeon). A general sentence on Roman-Byzantine 'water storage installations, oil presses, churches' gives no site; unlocated, not coded. No site-specific feature of the eligible classes inside the boxes.
tier1_record: Kh. Almit: two passing mentions (printed p. 23, PDF p. 28); extraction only in part_a/tier1_kh_almit_extraction.md (2b2a4bc), committed after this row was first committed (ac45765); nothing coded from them

title: מדבר יהודה ובקעת הירדן (חולייה מס' 6) (emergency survey, Judean Desert and Jordan Valley)
author: P. Bar-Adon
location_note: Judean Desert, Jericho plains and Jordan Valley to the Damiya bridge (Z2, Z3); no map references.
notes: About 300 sites. The caves sub-section ('המערות', printed p. 28) was read to its first lines only and held as a precaution (cave survey whose areas were not established; plan section 7). Iron Age forts and wall lines not eligible.

features.subtype: ancient water cisterns found with forts, buildings and wall lines (Iron Age section of the report)
features.period: listed in the report's Israelite-period section; not dated individually
features.quote: בסקר שלנו נתגלו מצודות רבות מבנים בורות מים קדומים

features.site: el-Auja et-Tahta, Kh. Fasail and other Jordan Valley sites
features.subtype: aqueducts not known before
features.period: Roman
features.quote: נרשמו גם אמות-מים ודרכים רומיות

features.site: above Nahal Arugot towards En Gedi; north of Wadi Murabba'at; outlet of Wadi en-Nar
features.subtype: caves in the wadi adapted as water pools, with steps and paths to the springs, by dry-stone settlements
features.period: main finds Roman; built for temporary dwelling probably in the Bar Kokhba period
features.quote: בתוך הואדי מערות שהותקנו כבריכות מים

features.subtype: inhabited caves near the dry-stone settlements
features.period: probably the Bar Kokhba period (main finds Roman, also Byzantine use)
features.quote: בקרבת היישובים האלה מערות שאף הן היו מיושבות

title: יהודה (חולייה מס' 7) (emergency survey, Judea)
author: M. Kochavi
location_note: Judean hills from Jerusalem to the Negev border and the high Shephelah; the in-region part is the Bethlehem-Gush Etzion-Betar-Tekoa area (Z4). No map references.
notes: Features named are outside the boxes (tombs near Adoraim and Ziph; a nefesh at Ziph; decorated tombs near a Kh. Samiya and Kh. Juf in the Hebron hills). Inside Z4: Israelite settlements near Gush Etzion, forts on the Elah-Bethlehem road, Kh. Abu Shun and Roman forts around Betar, the Tekoa road; none of the eligible classes.

title: ירושלים: קברים יהודיים בגבעת המבתר (Jerusalem, Jewish tombs at Giv'at ha-Mivtar)
author: V. Tzaferis
location_note: Giv'at ha-Mivtar, north Jerusalem; no map reference.
notes: Four tomb caves; the text layer of the first page is badly garbled. Ossuaries with inscriptions ('Simon builder of the Temple'; Yehohanan son of Hagqol, heel bones joined by a nail). Cave 2 with Hasmonean pottery.

features.subtype: rock-cut kokhim tombs with ossuaries
features.period: second half of the 1st century BCE to the third quarter of the 1st century CE (tomb 1)
features.quote: שקבר זה שייך לפרק זמן שבין המחצית השנייה של המאה

title: ירושלים: בנייני האומה (Jerusalem, Binyanei ha-Umma)
author: M. Avi-Yonah
location_note: Binyanei ha-Umma grounds, Jerusalem; no map reference.
notes: Pottery kiln of the end of the Second Temple period, Tenth Legion brick and tile works; Byzantine refuse pits and installations (not eligible).

title: ירושלים: רחוב אלפסי (Jerusalem, Alfasi Street)
author: (Department of Antiquities)
location_note: 54 Alfasi Street, Jerusalem; no map reference.

features.subtype: burial chamber with four kokhim and a central pit
features.period: end of the Second Temple period; Herodian juglet
features.quote: מערת קברים מסוף ימי הבית השני נתגלתה בעת בניית מקלם

title: ירושלים: קרית יובל (Jerusalem, Qiryat Yovel)
author: A. Eitan
location_note: Qiryat Yovel, Jerusalem; no map reference.

features.subtype: rock-cut cave entered by a vertical shaft, five slab-covered burial troughs
features.period: Byzantine (sherds)
features.quote: בחלקה התחתון של המערה חצובות חמש שקתות קבורה

title: אתר עתיק בסביבת יריחו (ancient site near Jericho)
author: G. M. Landes
location_note: About 3 km north of Jericho by the widened road; no map reference.
notes: Strata: Early Roman (1st century CE), Iron II (late 7th-early 6th century BCE) houses, late Chalcolithic round building and granary (not eligible).

features.subtype: small water cistern with Early Roman pottery at the bottom and a coin of Valerius Gratus (17/18 CE)
features.period: Early Roman (1st century CE)
features.quote: השרידים מתקופה זו כוללים בור מים קטן

title: ח' סמרא במדבר יהודה (Kh. Samra in the Judean Desert)
author: P. Bar-Adon
location_note: North bank of Nahal Arugot; no map reference.
notes: Dry-stone dwelling cells with benches, hearths, granaries and wall niches; Byzantine pottery (5th-6th centuries CE); probably monks or hermits. No feature of the eligible classes.

title: הפעולה הארכיאולוגית ביהודה ושומרון: עין סאמיה (Ein Samiya cemetery)
author: (Judea and Samaria staff officer)
screen_note: Spelling 'סאמיה' of the gazetteer's 'סמיה' (prefix and spelling variant).
location_note: Ein Samiya area east of Kafr Malik on the Jericho-Ramallah road; no map reference.

features.subtype: large cemetery of shaft tombs (shaft about 6 m deep, low vaulted chamber)
features.period: Middle Bronze I, with Middle Bronze II secondary burials
features.quote: נתגלה בית קברות נרחב מתקופת הברונזה התיכונה

title: הפעולה הארכיאולוגית ביהודה ושומרון: שומרון — מערת קברים ממזרח לשכם (tomb cave east of Shechem)
author: (Judea and Samaria staff; inspector Ibrahim Amin el-Fani)
location_note: About 3 km east of Shechem (text); sub-item of the Samaria district notes. INFERENCE: inside the Z1 box.
notes: Other Samaria-district notes (a Hellenistic pool of 25 m³ and a cistern with a reused Herodian column at Samaria-Sebaste) are outside the boxes and not coded.

features.subtype: tomb cave with six kokhim and a stone coffin
features.period: two burial phases, 4th and 5th-6th centuries CE (coins)
features.quote: נחשפה מערת קברים כ־־ 3 ק״מ ממזרח לשכם

title: שכם ותל אר-ראס - 1968 (Shechem and Tell er-Ras 1968)
author: E. F. Campbell and H. O. Thompson; R. G. Boling, J. F. Ross, L. E. Toombs
location_note: Tell Balata and Tell er-Ras (north spur of Mount Gerizim above Balata); no map reference.
notes: Tell er-Ras: Hadrianic temple of Zeus Hypsistos (about 130 CE) on a Hellenistic platform; Byzantine fortification and chapel; 'several structures related to water supply from the time of Constantine' (not described, not coded). Tell Balata: Amarna-period cellar with pottery (not eligible).

features.subtype: row of plastered cisterns along the north side of the courtyard walls, originally vaulted
features.period: last use in the time of Constantine (4th century CE); construction not dated
features.quote: בורות אלה היו מקומרים במקורם ונשתמרו היטב

features.subtype: deep rock-cut moat separating the sacred site from the rest of the mountain
features.period: not dated in the report
features.quote: היא חפיר שנחצב כדי להפריד את האתר הקדוש

title: הפעולה הארכיאולוגית ביהודה ושומרון: צור באהר (Sur Bahir tomb)
author: (inspector Azmi Khalil Mustafa)
location_note: Sur Bahir near Jerusalem; no map reference.

features.subtype: burial cave with ossuary fragments and Herodian lamps
features.period: end of the Second Temple period; coin of Pontius Pilate (32 CE)
features.quote: סערת קבורה מסוף ימי הבית השני נבדקה בכפר צור באהר
